facts.business: Innovative Tech Pack Limited manufactures and supplies packaging products to major FMCG, food, and pharmaceutical companies.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: (a) Debtors of Rs. 1309.49 Lakhs with Rs. 141.20 Lakhs under NCLT litigation; (b) Contract worker wages above PF/ESI limits, cash payments; (c) Trade receivables/payables subject to reconciliation; (d) Bonus of Rs. 15.32 Lakhs (prior years) and Rs. 13.46 Lakhs (FY26) pending/unverified; (e) Unpaid interest on MSME dues beyond 45 days; (f) No internal audit appointment per Section 138 for FY26.

key_risks: Significant debtor litigation (Rs. 141.20 Lakhs under NCLT)
Non-compliance with PF/ESI for contract workers
Non-payment of interest on MSME dues
Absence of internal audit as per Companies Act
GST compliance complexity across multiple jurisdictions
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions are on arm's length basis and in compliance with Companies Act and Listing Regulations. No materially significant transactions with promoters/directors/KMP. Details in Note 31 to Standalone Financial Statements.
